extension.summary: Up opens the OSD and Down closes it, instead of skipping ten minutes
extension.description:
Kodi maps Up and Down during video playback to a ten minute skip, and on a TV remote those are the two easiest buttons to press by accident. You meet it when you play a programme from the guide: Up and Down jump ten minutes through it.
This add-on gives them something a remote can use instead. Up opens the player OSD, Down closes it again, and neither one seeks.
Live TV never had the problem and does not change: Kodi gives it a keymap of its own, where Up and Down are channel up and channel down, and this add-on leaves that alone. There is one exception worth knowing. While the OSD is open, Down closes it whatever you are watching, live included, because the OSD is the same window in both cases. In this skin that costs one shortcut inside the OSD, from the timeline down to the row of buttons; that row is still reachable with Up and then Left.
The keymap is written into your profile and reloaded in place, so it applies without restarting Kodi. Turning the setting off removes it again.
